stories.title: Introduire l’alias cfg unique du backend Ghostty

local_gates_passed: cargo test -p paneflow-app --test ghostty_cfg_policy: 2 passed, plus a standalone negative control (rustc --test against a tree containing the forbidden motif) that fails as expected
local_gates_blocked: QG-002 Linux and Windows neutrality: cannot be produced on an Apple Silicon dev machine, needs the CI matrix on the candidate commit.
verification.environment_note: Building paneflow-app on macOS requires full Xcode, not Command Line Tools: gpui_macos compiles src/shaders.metal in its build script via `xcrun metal`, and on Xcode 26+ the Metal toolchain is a separately downloaded component. `cmake` is also required transitively by wasmtime-c-api-impl.
verification.note: QG-001 est vert sur aarch64-apple-darwin. Le refactor est prouvé complet par inventaire avant/après (172 -> 5 expressions restantes, toutes intentionnelles). Seul l'arm macOS (alias absent) a été compilé; les arms Linux et Windows ne peuvent l'être que par la CI. US-001 reste IN_PROGRESS jusqu'à QG-002.
